title: Molecular verification and new host record for the pea crab Pinnotheres pholadis De Haan, 1835 sensu lato (Decapoda: Brachyura: Pinnotheridae) in northern Japan
content:
Abstract
Pea crabs (Pinnotheridae) associate with many marine invertebrates, but molecular data for Japanese species remain scarce. We examined pinnotherids inhabiting the mantle cavity of cultured Japanese scallops, Mizuhopecten yessoensis (Jay, 1857), from Mutsu Bay, northern Japan, and generated mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I (COI) sequences. Six host-crab sets were obtained from small scallops of the same cultured cohort, and COI sequences were obtained from four crabs. The four sequences were identical and differed by two substitutions across a 506-bp alignment from the single independent Chinese mitogenome sequence available for Pinnotheres pholadis De Haan, 1835. Because the Chinese reference sequence lacks detailed published morphological documentation and P. pholadis has unresolved taxonomic boundaries, we treat the identification as provisional and refer to the specimens as P. pholadis sensu lato. We provide the first COI data for Japanese material assignable to P. pholadis sensu lato and document M. yessoensis as a new host. These data provide a basis for future integrative taxonomic and ecological studies of pinnotherid crabs in scallop aquaculture systems.
